subject.title: refactor: remove browser and codex dead exports

question: Are all removed browser and Codex exports confirmed internal-only rather than shipped plugin, integration, or supported test-contract surfaces?
rationale: The PR removes a broad API-shaped surface, carries a protected maintainer label, and cannot safely pass without explicit ownership of external compatibility and sibling Codex contracts.

options.title: Complete contract audit
options.body: Verify published barrels, package exports, tagged releases, external consumers, deleted-test coverage, and sibling Codex contracts before merging the full cleanup.

options.title: Narrow the cleanup
options.body: Land only clearly file-private exports now and defer ambiguous runtime or plugin-facing surfaces to focused follow-up PRs.

options.title: Accept compatibility risk
options.body: Merge the full cleanup only with explicit maintainer ownership that undocumented external imports may stop working.

recommendation.title: Complete contract audit
recommendation.body: Verify published barrels, package exports, tagged releases, external consumers, deleted-test coverage, and sibling Codex contracts before merging the full cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history connects this person to both the enforced dead-export baseline and the coordinated cleanup under review.
